title: How big is a 1 carat emerald cut?

post.youtube_title: How big is a 1 carat emerald cut?
post.caption:
A 1 carat emerald cut measures about 7.0 by 5.0 millimeters. A 2 carat emerald cut covers 38% of the width of a size 6 finger.

Emerald cut diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/emerald-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts

Estimates for a well-cut stone.
